name: PF1e Bestiary
note: M16: the mass-battle unit mirrors the strategic engine deploys from, one entry per PRECREATED_PF1E_UNITS role (40 rows, which is the box's ~30 ask met by every role the engine actually fields). Each entry's `system.pf1e` block is what compiles into a unit profile; `system.mirror` records the authored facts (hit dice, progression, speed, the mirror's CR, which saves are good) and states which numbers are derived from the shared SRD tables rather than typed in. tests/packages/pf1eContentPacks.test.ts recomputes every derived field, and tests/packages/pf1ePackage.test.ts compiles each entry against the profile table. No entry claims to be a Bestiary stat-line transcription — that is R02 work.

system.notes: Mass-battle profile mirror of PRECREATED_PF1E_UNITS.infantry. Hit points default to 10 per model until the profile table carries hp (Gap List §1.3); tests/packages/pf1ePackage.test.ts pins this file against the table by compiled profile, and tests/packages/pf1eContentPacks.test.ts recomputes the derived numbers.
rangeIncrement is in feet; the sim still ignores range increments for non-firearm attacks (Gap List §2.8).
The hero marker a mass-battle unit must also carry (unit.type 'hero' or stats.hero = 1) lives on the Unit document, not here — see Gap List §5.

mirror.derived: bab comes from the progression ladder in rulesTables.ts (`babAtLevel`) and `baseSaves` from `saveBonusAtLevel`, as the ladder alone: the pool sim reads a published save as a total while the tactical rules add the ability modifier to it, which is the pinned cross-scale difference of Gap List §10.2 (D-226), so the sheet supplies the modifier and this row does not double it. AC is 10 + the size column of Table 8-4 + Dexterity + natural armor + armor + shield, and touchAc drops the worn bonuses. tests/packages/pf1eContentPacks.test.ts recomputes every one of them; the saves live in this mirror block rather than in `pf1e` because the mass engine reads no save column, and authoring a total on the profile side would freeze one scale's answer into content.
